fields.is_recruited: true for each recruited role; false for a future explicit removal
fields.recruited_by: No local value today; must be set from an authenticated administrator by a future SQL adapter
fields.recruited_at: No local value today; populate only when recruitment time is known

agency_agents.note: No rows seeded. Runtime default ceo is not automatically inserted by SQL. Prompts and skills remain versioned files from roster.json, not credentials or per-client data in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.client_id: clientId; convert empty string to SQL NULL for shared agency sources
fields.created_by: No local value today; authenticated administrator in a future adapter

agent_sources.note: URL is a reference only. No fetch, crawler, connector or retrieval service is started by SQL.

fields.requested_model: model captured before execution; empty may mean CLI default
fields.steps: steps JSON array preserving role, content, actual model, usage and completedAt
fields.updated_at: No local value today; SQL adapter would set it at mutation

agent_runs.note: One active queued/running run and one run per non-null onboarding_id. Source/campaign/onboarding client scope checked when assigned; deleted source IDs can remain as historical references. Revalidate actual content at execution. Role slugs and prompts validated against versioned roster by application.

deliverables.content: TEXT nullable; final Markdown/text body, never interpreted as a filesystem path
deliverables.provider: Nullable provider used to execute generation
deliverables.model: Nullable actual model returned by the provider; never fill with requested model if unknown
deliverables.relative_path: Historical metadata remains; serving content does not authorize reading an arbitrary local path

access.agency_agents: service_role only; server must require an authenticated active admin
access.agent_sources: service_role only; server must require an authenticated active admin and validate client scope
access.agent_runs: service_role only; server must require an authenticated active admin and validate client scope

limitations: No migration/import of existing local JSON is provided or executed.
No SQL adapter, synchronization, listener, job worker or cron is activated.
No real credentials, jobs, roster records, clients or sources are seeded.
The service_role bypasses RLS. SQL privileges do not replace HTTP authentication/authorization.
Local queue behavior and SQL constraints are separate implementations; runtime execution remains in local files.
